storyCards.fact:
Lil Jon's "Snap Yo Fingers" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 28 weeks on the chart.

Snap Yo Fingers was released in 2006.
